description: Add, change or remove on-screen text in a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot; left out: the shot on screen). preset is one of the style's text presets (its look and font); action is its animation (pop, slam, type, fade, slide, drop...). Ids must come from the current style: call library to see them (a wrong id is refused with the valid list). Returns the shot and text ids. One undo step for the person. For a script line that is spoken, use script with action write or assign (its captions come from the voice).

at.description: When it appears, in % through the shot (0 to 100)

font.description: A font family the style offers, or "".

id.description: Text id, for change and remove.

line_words.description: Words per line (2 if left out).

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

until.description: When it leaves, in % through the shot (0 to 100)

when.description: Rough timing in the shot. Use at for an exact %.

words.description: The text. Short reads best: 2 to 5 words.

x.description: Centre across, in % of the frame (50 is the middle).

y.description: Centre down, in % of the frame (18 is near the top; captions sit near 84).

name: set_text
